- CUDA: cache the device type at init
ggml_backend_cuda_device_get_type called cudaGetDeviceProperties on every
call, which takes ~0.7-1 ms with the CUDA 12 runtime. With tensor
overrides on multiple GPUs the scheduler queries the device type for every
split input, so this ran dozens of times per token.
Store the device type in ggml_cuda_device_info at init. It is derived from
prop.integrated, not from the integrated flag, which is forced off ( #15034 ).
